title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: How to determine whether the current environment is Sandbox or Production
summary: Determining whether a Business Central environment is Sandbox or Production can be done through multiple methods: checking the Help & Support page, using company badges that differ by shape (round for production, square for sandbox), accessing the App Launcher, or using the Environment Information codeunit.
key_points: Production environments are for running daily business operations on performance tiers with high availability, while Sandbox environments are for testing and development
Environment names may not reliably indicate the actual environment type, requiring verification methods
The Help & Support page's Report a Problem tab shows the environment type in the Microsoft Extra Tenant ID
Company badges automatically reflect environment type and appear round for production or square for sandbox
Alternative technical methods include using the App Launcher or codeunit 457 Environment Information

quotes.text: A round company badge signifies a production environment, and a square badge signifies a sandbox environment.
quotes.why_it_matters: Provides a quick visual way to identify environment type without admin access
